role: persistent woody cover that protects soil and supplies terrestrial forage structure
silhouette: A seeded trunk-to-branch hierarchy carrying a faceted clustered crown; sheltered trees spread, conifers taper, exposed trees trail downwind, and mangroves stand above saltwater on radial stilt roots.

discrete.name: growthGuild
discrete.driver: temperature, elevation, exposure, slope, salinity, and inundation

source.tool: @dgreenheck/ez-tree pinned at dcf309bd86bd521083d9c70f01f2de45fdc7c457 plus Epoch build-time foliage/root meshing
source.procedure: Run npm run asset:tree:generate. The script bundles the pinned ez-tree source only during authoring, maps four Epoch habitat guilds onto seeded skeleton parameters, adds mangrove stilt roots, converts leaf anchors to Epoch faceted clusters, emits shared-skeleton near/far buffers, and records triangle budgets.
